## Description

Provide a clear description of your changes and the problem they solve.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature / lint rule (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have run `pnpm run compile` and confirmed no TypeScript errors
- [ ] I have run `pnpm test` and all existing & new tests pass
- [ ] I have added unit tests covering my changes
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README if applicable
- [ ] I have added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md`
